sourceMethods: All 128 active subnet slots and their current profiles reviewed. 72 dated September 7–8 SubnetRadar briefs checked against the previous edition.

Signed-in X Latest searches covered all 128 SN numbers and current names or aliases in 16 grouped queries, with additional ecosystem-account searches and original-thread follow-ups. Grok was used to discover leads, not as publication evidence.

81 public account candidates sampled and refreshed; 132 unique in-window posts retrieved. Full original posts were opened for material announcements, including Cats, Stonk, RedTeam, NIOME, Cacheon, Ditto, Score and Hippius.

All 152 mapped repository paths checked with paginated commit retrieval through 10:49 AM ET; 147 accessible. Selected primary diffs, README files, release records and product pages checked for activation limits.
Authenticated AlphaGap feed reviewed: 38 visible cards, with current leads separated from older posts. TAO Daily, TAO Media, SubnetRadar and the public subnet feed provided additional discovery.
Partner-side checks included Mantle, MoonPay, Sunrise and Verathos. Verathos’s Testnet selector was used to confirm the SN92 model listing; its mainnet table did not contain that model.

YouTube Videos and Live tabs refreshed. Latest public upload verified as L3wLKIoYz1c, 22:44. RL Bryer stream remains scheduled for September 9 at 16:00 UTC; latest members video remains September 6, 10:11.

Current network prices and emissions compared with yesterday’s saved snapshot. Subnet price badges use rolling 24-hour α/TAO. CONST’s separate USD snapshot is timestamped in its story. Research cutoff: 10:49 AM ET.
accessGaps: X results were sampled, not exhaustively paginated. Group queries used Bittensor/TAO/subnet context to reduce unrelated matches and excluded replies; public account samples and selected full threads supplemented them. Private, deleted, unindexed and unsampled posts can still be missing.

Private Discord history was not accessed directly. SubnetRadar and AlphaGap are discovery sources, and a statement in a subnet channel is not automatically a team statement. Desearch’s proposal, Vidaio’s activation, Iota’s reported burn transaction and the pending SN73 key swap remain incompletely verified.

Five mapped repository paths returned errors: deprecated/deprecated, actual-computer/actual-subnet-95, Satori119/Satori, NIOME-BITTENSOR/NIOME and Oh-My-Ditto/ditto. Historical aliases can redirect or refer to old projects; primary attribution was checked for published stories.

Refinery’s identity, website and code are confirmed, but its source warns against inferring active deployment. BitMind’s 80% burn is a code setting, while its observed subnet emission share remains zero. Subtensor 455 mainnet activation was not established.

TAOstatus’s reported mainnet launch conflicts with testnet-focused README instructions and health-check usage in its documentation. Conjectures and UMI source changes do not by themselves establish production activation.

Market data is a timestamped provider snapshot. Stonk and Bitcast revenue and buybacks are project-published totals, not an independent reconciliation. CONST holder distributions were not audited; no causal link from memecoin activity to TAO’s price is asserted.

Prior-day stories are repeated only where there is a material follow-up or missing context, with dates stated. No verified forward alpha-unlock calendar was found. Routine commits, recycled launches, price forecasts and unsupported misconduct allegations were excluded. Posts after the cutoff belong to the next edition.

editorialDecisions.decision: Yesterday’s saved Minos emission share was zero; today it is positive. Ror is a Tensia co-founder, not a Minos founder. His September 9 miner-burn plan is separately attributed.

The current registry links Refinery’s site and repository. The primary README warns that source availability does not establish deployment. Do not claim six weeks of guaranteed emissions or unverified investor involvement.

An 80% baseline burn supersedes the earlier 100% code. This applies to emission allocation, not registration fees. Source version is v5.0.2; latest formal GitHub release remains v5.0.0. No payout restoration inferred while network share is zero.
MicroTensor corrected its mistagged partner handle to @verathos_ai. The receiving product’s Testnet SN405 table lists MT Code 3G with 32k context and one miner; the mainnet table does not.
OpenRoboto’s new seven-task, 70-trial suite is distinct from yesterday’s physical-track allocation story. The shared catalog does not change a locked season. Unsupported allegations excluded.

CONST’s retracement is included after yesterday’s rally. Cats publicly backs the community and its market page points to his account. No Jacob Steeves creator claim. USD price is distinct from alpha/TAO; Stonk totals are platform-wide.
Sunrise and MoonPay both confirm PayBox availability. MoonPay excludes US users. No TAO transaction was performed. The NKE launch is not a new TAO-pair launch.

The full September 6 thread supplies Lium’s missing methodology: B200 192GB, 256 streams, 512 output tokens, vLLM 0.28.0, aggregate throughput and GPU rental cost. Link the complete run URL and repository; do not claim single-user speed.
Endure’s September 7 announcement at 13:32 UTC preceded the previous cutoff, so it is labeled as a late follow-up. Testnet 504 does not establish mainnet SN30 activation.
TAOstatus’s launch brief conflicts with README testnet 501 instructions and product documentation identifying health checks as current usage. Mainnet and external-production claims remain developing.
Bitcast’s primary dashboard was checked instead of treating a commentator as a company source. Cumulative totals and latest receipt date are explicit. No future buyback promised.
Capcomp’s market move is supported by the saved snapshot. No verified cause or wrongdoing is inferred, and an old validator fix is not reported as new.
Chutes’ CEO appointment was covered September 7. No additional leadership announcement was verified. The community revenue-page dispute does not establish motive.
SN76 still has a null name and zero emissions in the current registry. Grok’s Noon branding lead was not corroborated and is not published as verified.
A gRidges greeting is not a new subnet launch. AlphaGap’s v0.3.0 lead was not confirmed as a new in-window primary announcement.
Leadpoet’s high commit volume largely concerns testnet, rehearsal and bootstrap work. Do not infer a mainnet launch or a Dropbox contract.
Exploit Summit is a conference; its name is not evidence of a chain exploit. Community emission proposals are not activated runtime rules.
The latest public YouTube episode is now the default eligible video. Membership and stream entries remain current. Dated report files before September 8 remain unchanged.
